 Court No. - 13
 Hon'Ble Subhash Vidyarthi, J.

1. Heard Shri Syed Tamjeed Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant, Smt. Shikha Sinha, learned
A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.1564 of 2019, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. registered at Police Station- Gomti Nagar, District- Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. alleging that the informant had made some investment in a Project of Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company but no return was paid on his investment.

entities.text: Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It has further been stated that the applicant was a Director of the Company since January, 2015 to July 2017.5.
In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant's involvement in 50 other cases has been disclosed in para 15 of the affidavit, all of which are similar in nature and the applicant has been granted bail in 22 cases.

Co-accused Amitabh Kumar Srivastava, who was the Additional Director of the Company has been granted bail by this court in the present case by means of an order dated 23.04.2025, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2799 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2799 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 23.11.2021 and the learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that even the charges have not been framed in the matter till date.

6. Learned AGA-I has vehemently opposed the bail application and she has submitted that the applicant is involved in a large scale financial fraud affecting a very large number of persons and,
therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
However, she could not refute the submissions of the learned counsel for the applicant that even charges have not been framed till date.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the purpose of keeping an under trial person in custody is to ensure his availability to face the trial and the trial has not even commenced in spite of a period of more than four years has been elapsed since the applicant was taken into custody, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
